summary: Per-frame audio DSP state update. When the float threshold at this+0x8 is positive it accumulates the incoming time (a2) with the stored offset at this+0x14, dispatches an interrupt, then walks the scene-graph children (count via SceneGraphChildCount on this+0x0) and conditionally dispatches each indexed child with the stored scene reference at this+0xC. Afterwards it always fetches a scene-node position and, when the DSP object at this+0x4 is non-null, calls its vtable method at slot +4 with literals 2, 1065353216 and 0, passing the fetched position, a zeroed scratch array and flt_7CF2CC. Finally it advances the linked state at this+0x10: ScrollingDataOffsetAcrossLinkedEntries when a2 equals the previous value at this+0x18, LinkedListAnimationTimerDecrement otherwise, always storing a2 back into this+0x18 and returning the call result (or the raw bits of a2 when the linked pointer is null). Called by sub_4D4580.

local_names.v10: accumulated time passed to the per-child dispatch
local_names.v11: zeroed scratch array passed to the DSP method

operations.description: Interrupt/dispatch block is gated on the float at this+0x8 being greater than 0.0
Accumulates the incoming time into v3 = a2 + this+0x14
InterruptDispatch invoked with the accumulated time
SceneGraphChildCount run on the scene root handle at this+0x0 to obtain the child count
Iterates the scene-graph children: LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230 per index, then ConditionalDispatchByFlag with the scene reference at this+0xC and the accumulated time
SceneNodePositionGetter always called to fill the position outputs
Vtable dispatch on the DSP object at this+0x4 (vtable slot at +0, method pointer at +4): called with arguments 2, position, zeroed scratch, flt_7CF2CC, 1065353216 and 0
The scratch array v11 passed to the DSP method is zeroed with memset
Linked-state advance only when the pointer at this+0x10 is non-null; otherwise the raw bits of a2 become the result
When a2 equals the stored previous value at this+0x18, ScrollingDataOffsetAcrossLinkedEntries is called on the linked pointer; otherwise LinkedListAnimationTimerDecrement is called
this+0x18 is written back to a2 on both the linked and null-linked paths, and the branch result (or a2) is returned
Invoked by the audio update driver sub_4D4580
